'''''Streptocarpus ionanthus''''' ([[Synonym (taxonomy)|synonym]] '''''Saintpaulia ionantha''''') is a [[species]] of ''[[Streptocarpus]]'' in the section ''[[Streptocarpus sect. Saintpaulia|Saintpaulia]]'', commonly known as an African violet. It is native to eastern and southwestern [[Tanzania]].<ref name=POWO_77117375-1/>

==Infraspecific taxa==
[[File:Streptocarpus ionanthus by Chandralekha CT.jpg|thumb|Streptocarpus ionanthus (H.Wendl.) Christenh.]]
{{As of|2020|March}}, ''[[Plants of the World Online]]'' accepted the following subspecies and varieties. Many have previously been treated as separate species in the no longer recognized genus ''Saintpaulia''.<ref name=POWO_77117375-1/>
*''Streptocarpus ionanthus'' var. ''diplotrichus'' <small>(B.L.Burtt) Christenh.</small> (syn. ''Saintpaulia diplotricha'')
*''Streptocarpus ionanthus'' subsp. ''grandifolius'' <small>(B.L.Burtt) Christenh.</small> (syn. ''Saintpaulia grandifolia'')
*''Streptocarpus ionanthus'' subsp. ''grotei'' <small>(Engl.) Christenh.</small> (syn. ''Saintpaulia amaniensis'', ''Saintpaulia confusa'', ''Saintpaulia difficilis'', ''Saintpaulia grotei'', ''Saintpaulia magungensis'')
*''Streptocarpus ionanthus'' subsp. ''mafiensis'' <small>(I.Darbysh. & Pócs) Christenh.</small>
*''Streptocarpus ionanthus'' subsp. ''occidentalis'' <small>(B.L.Burtt) Christenh.</small>
*''Streptocarpus ionanthus'' subsp. ''orbicularis'' <small>(B.L.Burtt) Christenh.</small> (syn. ''Saintpaulia orbicularis'')
*''Streptocarpus ionanthus'' subsp. ''pendulus'' <small>(B.L.Burtt) Christenh.</small> (syn. ''Saintpaulia intermedia'', ''Saintpaulia pendula'')
*''Streptocarpus ionanthus'' subsp. ''rupicola'' <small>(B.L.Burtt) Christenh.</small> (syn. ''Saintpaulia rupicola'')
*''Streptocarpus ionanthus'' subsp. ''velutinus'' <small>(B.L.Burtt) Christenh.</small> (syn. ''Saintpaulia velutina'')
